title.vi: Sắc lệnh Khu vực được bảo vệ năm 2018
title.th: คำสั่งสถานที่ที่ได้รับการคุ้มครอง พ.ศ. 2561

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-28-2018-PROTECTED-PLACES-ORDER-2018.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 4 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Protected Places Order, 2018 and shall commence on the date it is made.

The places specified in the first column of the Schedule hereto, which are more particularly described in the plans specified in the second column thereof deposited in the office of the Surveyor-General, are hereby declared to be a protected places for the purposes of the Act.
The authorities specified in the third column of the Schedule hereto are from whom permission to enter that protected place is to be received. Amendment of 01 of Chapter 147

The Schedule to the Protected Places (Consolidation) Order is amended by deleting item 20.

SCHEDULE (paragraphs 2 and 3) Places Plan Numbers Authority Detention and Rehabilitation GT120003BM Director of Internal Security Unit Internal Security Department Office of the Prime Minister Buildings and area GT160001BM Permanent Secretary to the Office of the Prime Minister Office of the Prime Minister Kampung Melabau Mukim Kianggeh Brunei Muara District Dated this 15th. day of Rejab, 1439 Hijriah corresponding to the 2nd. day of April, 2018.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA SERI KERNA DATO SERI SETIA (DR.) HAJI AWANG ABU BAKAR BIN HAJI APONG Minister of Home Affairs, Brunei Darussalam.
